explanation: The Home Army rose in August 1944 to take Warsaw before the Red Army reached it, so that Poland would be freed by its own government rather than handed a new one. Katyn is why that had become the object. The discovery of the graves in April 1943, and the Polish request for a Red Cross investigation, gave Moscow the pretext to break with the London government. The Soviet authorities then put together a rival Polish administration. The rising was an answer to that position. Whether the Red Army halted at the Vistula for military or political reasons is disputed, and this edge does not decide it.
